h1: Saas-Fee ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Saas-Fee sits at 1,800 metres in a cirque of 4,000-metre peaks in Valais, and the village is car-free. The operator runs 150 kilometres of slopes up to 3,600 metres above sea level, with a season from 31 October 2026 to 18 April 2027 - the neighbouring Saas-Grund and Saas-Almagell run a shorter winter, 19 December to 4 April.
stayOverview: Saas-Fee itself is car-free, with the car park at the village entrance. Saas-Grund and Saas-Almagell are further down the same valley, cheaper and on their own shorter winter season.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Staying in Saas-Fee means leaving the car at the entrance; the other villages in the valley are a bus ride away.
rentalCars: Saas-Fee is reached by postbus from Visp, and cars stop at the village entrance.
